Definition: Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Korah = "bald"; 1) son of Izhar, grandson of Kohath, great grandson of Levi and leader of the rebellion of the Israelites against Moses and Aaron while in the wilderness; punished and died by an earthquake and flames of fire; 2) the 3rd son of Esau by Aholibamah and one of the dukes of Edom; 3) son of Eliphaz by Adah, duke of Edom, and nephew of 1; 4) one of the 'sons' of Hebron
